cases.purpose: Project only the caller-matching advertised policy, reject changed content or metadata, and never treat listing as approval.
cases.oracle: The previously qualified caller-projection fixture, independent SHA-256 over private policy bytes, x86-64 UAPI fields, scoped per-inode stat controls and exact observed output. Root ownership is simulated only for the policy descriptor; actual root ownership and kernel policy enforcement are not proved.
cases.comparison: Setup proves a policy file actually owned by uid 2000 receives a synthetic uid-0 fstat response only for its inode, unrelated file stats remain real, and malformed policy-info size is rejected. Raw policy-info replies contain independently computed digest, real inode/times/mode, a private path, and a synthetic uid 0. Candidate -l/-ll/--list must render only the caller entry; empty and no-match cases return no entries; wrong digest, changing generation, real nonroot ownership, unsafe uid, and list-with-command are rejected without output or child marker. No AUTHZ/HANDOFF may occur. Listener bootstrap is precompiled and sends its listener before supervised operations; diagnostic stage files record the handoff. The source-review ownership and embedded-payload guard repairs are included. Setup records and validates every synthetic metadata result against the private target device/inode and actual fields; repeated observations of that same inode are allowed. The real-owner control remains mandatory.
cases.stdout: sudo-list projection=yes empty=yes binding=yes metadata=yes no-approval=yes
